mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, org_id, scope, is_primary, granted_by, granted_at FROM sys_user_org WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY is_primary DESC, granted_at DESC
SELECT id, user_id, org_id, scope, is_primary, granted_by, granted_at FROM sys_user_org WHERE org_id = #{orgId} ORDER BY granted_at DESC
SELECT id, user_id, org_id, scope, is_primary, granted_by, granted_at FROM sys_user_org WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_primary = TRUE LIMIT 1
